duration: Confidentiality obligation of 3 years from the date of signing.

financial_value.payment_terms: Not applicable — non-monetary confidentiality agreement. A liquidated damages penalty applies in case of breach (see penalty_clauses).

termination_clauses: Terminates automatically upon expiry of the 3-year confidentiality period, or by mutual written consent of the parties.
penalty_clauses: Liquidated damages of USD 50,000 payable by the Receiving Party in the event of breach.
governing_law: Laws of the United Arab Emirates as applied in the DIFC; jurisdiction of the DIFC Courts.
language_precedence_clause: In case of conflict, the Arabic version shall prevail.
